frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Griffin-Tversky: belief updating forms an impression from evidence strength (extremity, ~ sample proportion) then under-adjusts for weight (reliability, ~ sample size); explains overreaction to sample proportion and underreaction to sample size.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Strength-versus-Weight Theory of Biased Updating
